summary_en: 850,000 shares (1.31% of shares outstanding), ¥2,500M upper limit, execution period 2026-07-13 to 2026-08-21, Tokyo Stock Exchange market purchase via discretionary method. Proceeds to be allocated to third-party allotment share issuance related to subsidiary's acquisition of Kizuki International LLC interest.
title_en: Notification regarding determination of matters concerning acquisition of treasury shares (acquisition of treasury shares based on articles of incorporation under Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: On 10 July 2026, Yoshinoya HD's board of directors resolved to acquire up to 850,000 ordinary shares (1.31% of shares outstanding, calculated as 850,000 ÷ 65,129,558) for a maximum expenditure of ¥2,500 million. The acquisition will be executed via discretionary method on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 13 July and 21 August 2026. The treasury shares acquired will be allocated to a third-party allotment issuance related to the company's subsidiary acquisition of an interest in Kizuki International LLC, announced separately on the same date. The stated purposes are to enhance capital efficiency and enable flexible capital-allocation execution.
